capabilities: Render fenced url-cards blocks as responsive card grids in Reading view and Live Preview
Convert selected URLs or Markdown links into a url-cards block via a command
Automatically turn link-only paragraphs and uniform link lists into card grids in Reading view
Force fixed column counts per block with a c=N option
Fetch, cache, and display site favicons for cards when enabled
disambiguation: Not a URL cleaner or shortener; it renders lists of web links as visual card grids in note views.
extras: Favicon fetching is off by default; when enabled, requests reveal your IP address to linked sites, and the cache must be cleared manually to refresh icons.
problem: Obsidian renders web links only as ordinary text links, with no visual card layout for link lists.

relations.evidence: inspired by Material for MkDocs cards

summary: Link-list renderer that turns web links into responsive, Material-inspired card grids via url-cards blocks or automatic Reading-view conversion.
